question: The habit of excessive admiration for oneself, especially appearance
solution: His narcissism made it difficult for him to focus on anyone else's needs. अपने आप पर ही मुग्ध रहने की आदत (आत्ममुग्धता)।

question: To guide the course of a ship, especially by using instruments or maps
solution: Sailors use GPS and traditional maps to navigate through the ocean. किसी जहाज़ या वाहन को रास्ता दिखाते हुए आगे बढ़ाना।

question: One who studies the occult meanings of numbers
solution: She consulted a numerologist to choose a lucky date. अंकों के रहस्यमयी अर्थों का अध्ययन करने वाला (अंक ज्योतिषी)।

question: One who does not follow accepted rules or beliefs
solution: He was a nonconformist who dressed differently from everyone else. समाज या परंपरा के नियमों को न मानने वाला।

question: The practice of giving unfair advantages to one's relatives
solution: Many people criticize nepotism in the film industry. अपनों या रिश्तेदारों को गलत तरीके से लाभ पहुँचाना (भाई-भतीजावाद)।

question: A person, animal or plant belonging originally to a particular place
solution: The tiger is a native of the Indian jungles. किसी स्थान का मूल निवासी।

question: A person or thing that has the same name as another
solution: I was named after my grandfather, so he is my namesake. वह व्यक्ति या वस्तु जिसका नाम किसी दूसरे के समान हो (हमनाम)।

question: The study or collection of coins
solution: Numismatics is a popular hobby for history lovers. सिक्कों और पदकों का अध्ययन करने वाला शास्त्र (मुद्राशास्त्र)।

question: A specialist in kidney diseases
solution: My uncle had to visit a nephrologist for his kidney stones. गुर्दा रोगों का विशेषज्ञ डॉक्टर।

question: A newly coined word, expression, or usage
solution: 'Selfie' was once a neologism, but now it's common. भाषा में इस्तेमाल होने वाला नया शब्द।

question: A deserved and unavoidable punishment for wrongdoing
solution: The corrupt official finally met his nemesis. वह बुरा अंत या सजा जिससे बचा न जा सके।

question: One who is between ninety and one hundred years of age
solution: My great-grandmother is a healthy nonagenarian. वह व्यक्ति जिसकी उम्र 90 से 99 वर्ष के बीच हो।

question: A delusion of suffering from a disease
solution: His constant health checkups were a result of nosomania. वह भ्रम जिसमें व्यक्ति को लगता है कि उसे कोई बीमारी है।

question: A sentimental longing for a period in the past
solution: Looking at old photos always fills me with nostalgia. पुरानी यादों को याद करके होने वाला सुखद दुख (पुरानी यादों की तड़प)।

question: Showing a lack of experience, wisdom, or judgement
solution: He was naive to believe that he could earn money without hard work. वह व्यक्ति जिसे दुनियादारी का अनुभव न हो (अनुभवहीन)।

question: A doctor who studies the nervous system and its disorders
solution: You should see a neurologist if you have frequent migraines. नसों या तंत्रिका तंत्र का विशेषज्ञ डॉक्टर।

question: A drug that induces drowsiness and relieves pain
solution: The doctor prescribed a narcotic to help the patient sleep after surgery. वह नशीला पदार्थ जो दर्द कम करे और नींद लाए।

question: A fluid secreted by flowers which is collected by bees
solution: Bees fly from flower to flower to collect nectar. फूलों का मीठा रस।

question: An extreme fear of darkness
solution: His nyctophobia makes him sleep with a light on. अँधेरे से लगने वाला बहुत अधिक डर।

question: A place where young plants or trees are grown for sale
solution: We bought some saplings from the local nursery. वह स्थान जहाँ छोटे पौधों को बेचने के लिए उगाया जाता है।

question: The scientific study of the nervous system and brain
solution: Recent advances in neuroscience have helped us understand memory. मस्तिष्क और नसों का व्यापक वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन।

question: Occurring at night
solution: Owls are nocturnal birds. रात के समय सक्रिय होने वाला या होने वाली घटना।

question: A system of naming things
solution: The binomial nomenclature is used to name plants and animals. चीज़ों के नाम रखने की वैज्ञानिक या औपचारिक प्रणाली।

question: A person who is new to a profession
solution: I'm still a novice at driving, so I go very slowly. वह व्यक्ति जिसे किसी काम का अनुभव न हो (नौसिखिया)।

question: The study of the nervous system and its disorders
solution: Neurology is a complex branch of medical science. स्नायु तंत्र का अध्ययन करने वाला विज्ञान।

question: So small or unimportant as to be not worth considering
solution: The cost of the repair was negligible. जो बहुत कम या नगण्य (unimportant) हो।

question: A person who studies or collects coins
solution: As a numismatist, he traveled the world to find ancient silver coins. वह व्यक्ति जो पुराने सिक्कों को इकट्ठा करता है या उनका अध्ययन करता है।

question: One who mediates in a deal or complex situation
solution: A professional negotiator was called to handle the hostage situation. दो पक्षों के बीच समझौता कराने वाला व्यक्ति।

question: Just beginning to exist or develop
solution: The online education industry is in its nascent stage in many countries. जो चीज़ अभी शुरुआती दौर में हो (नवजात)।

question: A hollow space in a wall for a statue or ornament
solution: He placed the ancient vase in a niche in the living room. दीवार के अंदर बनी छोटी जगह या आला।

question: A person who has recently started an activity
solution: As a neophyte in the tech world, he has a lot to learn. किसी काम को हाल ही में शुरू करने वाला नौसिखिया।

question: One who moves from place to place with no fixed home
solution: The desert nomads travel with their camels in search of water. वह व्यक्ति जिसका कोई स्थायी घर न हो (खानाबदोश)।

question: An unimportant person
solution: In that huge company, he felt like a mere nonentity. वह व्यक्ति जिसका कोई विशेष महत्व या प्रभाव न हो।

question: The quality of being new and original
solution: The novelty of the new software wore off once we realized it had many bugs. किसी चीज़ का नयापन या उसकी नवीनता।

question: A person having excessive admiration for oneself, especially appearance
solution: She is a total narcissist; she can't stop looking in the mirror. वह व्यक्ति जो अपनी सुंदरता या गुणों पर बहुत घमंड करता है।

question: Highly unpleasant or offensive
solution: He has a nasty habit of biting his nails. जो चीज़ बहुत ही खराब, गंदी या घृणित (highly unpleasant) हो।

question: The rejection of all religious and moral principles
solution: Nihilism suggests that life has no intrinsic meaning. वह विचारधारा जो सभी धार्मिक और नैतिक मूल्यों को नकारती है।

question: The sound made by a horse
solution: We heard the horse neighing in the stable. घोड़े की आवाज़ या हिनहिनाहट।

question: Well-known for being bad; a person of evil reputation
solution: He is a notorious criminal wanted in several states. वह व्यक्ति जो अपनी बुराई या गलत कामों के लिए प्रसिद्ध हो (कुख्यात)।

question: A transcendent state in which there is neither suffering nor desire
solution: In Buddhism, achieving nirvana is the ultimate goal. मोक्ष या परम शांति की अवस्था।

question: To successfully achieve or accomplish something
solution: She really nailed the audition and got the lead role. किसी कार्य को बहुत ही सफलतापूर्वक पूरा करना।

question: A short sleep, especially during the day
solution: I felt much better after taking a 20-minute nap. दिन के समय ली जाने वाली छोटी सी नींद या झपकी।

question: An account that tells the particulars of an act or event
solution: The book provides a gripping narrative of the war. किसी घटना या कार्य का विस्तृत विवरण या कथा।

question: Not willing to accept new ideas
solution: His narrow-minded attitude prevents him from seeing other perspectives. वह व्यक्ति जिसकी सोच संकुचित हो और जो नए विचारों को न माने।

question: The process of planning and directing a route
solution: Satellite navigation has made driving in new cities much easier. किसी यात्रा का मार्ग निर्धारित करने और उसे निर्देशित करने की प्रक्रिया।

question: An extreme fear of death or dead bodies
solution: His necrophobia was so intense that he couldn't even enter a cemetery. मृत्यु या मुर्दों से लगने वाला अत्यधिक डर।

question: A government by new or inexperienced rulers
solution: The new administration was criticized as a neocracy because of its many mistakes. वह शासन व्यवस्था जो नए या अनुभवहीन लोगों द्वारा चलाई जाए।

question: An extreme fear of clouds
solution: People with nephophobia feel anxious as soon as the sky turns grey. बादलों को देखकर होने वाला बहुत अधिक और बेतुका डर।

question: A user of the internet
solution: Netizens are expressing their opinions on the new law on social media. वह व्यक्ति जो इंटरनेट का सक्रिय रूप से उपयोग करता है।

question: An extreme fear of being without a mobile phone
solution: Nomophobia (No-Mobile-Phone Phobia) is increasingly common in the digital age. मोबाइल फोन के बिना होने या उसे खो देने का डर।

question: The small amount of toothpaste shown in advertisements
solution: Most people use way more toothpaste than the recommended nurdle. विज्ञापनों में दिखाया जाने वाला टूथपेस्ट का वह छोटा सा लहरनुमा हिस्सा।
